font.reason: A clear, variable-weight product UI sans suits the restrained two-option control, with dependable Persian glyph coverage and natural joining.

text.shaping: Persian text is rendered as whole words with Vazirmatn, no letter spacing, no per-character splitting, and no tracking. Both labels fit on one line within their original segment widths.
text.timing: Labels retain the original stable visible state; all float-in, cursor, press, ripple, thumb, and icon beats retain their original frame positions.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored: source پرسش is on the right and destination رایانه is on the left.
rtlDecisions.why: The two options express reading-order progression in an RTL interface.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored from right to left over frames 52–60, preserving the exact 8-frame cubic ease-out.
rtlDecisions.why: The thumb communicates progression from the initial mode to the destination mode.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored horizontally; enters from the left at frame 20 and reaches the left destination at frame 44. Vertical path and arrow silhouette stay unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The cursor approaches the destination segment in the mirrored layout; cursor shape is a physical pointer, not a text direction cue.

rtlDecisions.action: Repositioned to the mirrored destination click point while retaining its original 12-frame expansion and fade.
rtlDecisions.why: The ripple marks the click on the رایانه destination, not a directional decoration.

rtlDecisions.action: RTL flex order places each leading icon at the right of its Persian label; the question and smiling laptop drawings retain their physical shape.
rtlDecisions.why: Icon placement follows reading order, while the icons depict objects and keep their internal geometry.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept centered; entrance remains upward from below and spring parameters remain unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: Vertical motion is physical and the pill is horizontally symmetric.

components.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets are used; all graphic content is vector UI artwork with no baked-in text.

visualVerification.result: Verified the cursor approach, mid-slide and ripple, settled destination icon, and final hold against matching original frames. Persian labels join correctly and remain within the control.
